metadata.title: External Data Requirements Specification
metadata.objective: Define explicit technical requirements to anticipate sudden distress in SMEs under the strict 8% alert cap.

family_a_banking_cash_flow.description: High-frequency transaction-level bank account telemetry to monitor liquidity burn and cash-flow volatility.

fields.name: daily_gross_inflows
fields.description: Sum of all incoming account credits settling on observation date T_obs.

fields.name: daily_gross_outflows
fields.description: Sum of all outgoing account debits settling on observation date T_obs.

fields.name: eod_available_cash_balance
fields.description: End-of-day ledger balance net of encumbered funds and pending holds.

fields.name: rolling_30d_net_cash_flow_volatility
fields.description: Sample standard deviation of daily net cash flows over backward-looking 30-day window.

fields.name: nsf_returned_payment_count
fields.description: Count of bounced checks, returned ACH debits, or failed outward payments on date T_obs.

fields.name: overdraft_headroom_utilization
fields.description: Drawn balance divided by approved credit limit. Values > 1.0 indicate unapproved overdraft.

temporal_specifications.availability_timestamp_definition: API availability timestamp T_avail = T_obs + Delta_T, where Delta_T <= 24 hours.

family_a_banking_cash_flow.feasibility_rationale: SME acute distress typically presents as a liquidity run 30-60 days before legal insolvency; daily cash dynamics capture sudden depletion invisible to annual accrual ratios.

family_b_trade_credit_payment_behavior.description: Commercial B2B trade credit payment tape and supplier invoice aging records.

fields.name: invoice_settlement_date
fields.description: Date invoice was cleared/paid (or null if delinquent/unpaid).

fields.name: days_past_due_max
fields.description: Maximum days past due across all active outstanding supplier invoices.

fields.name: delinquency_amount_30_60_dpd
fields.description: Total monetary value of trade payables delinquent between 31 and 60 days.

fields.name: delinquency_amount_90plus_dpd
fields.description: Total monetary value of trade payables delinquent beyond 90 days.

fields.name: supplier_dispute_flag
fields.description: True if borrower has formal trade disputes, stop-shipments, or COD conversions logged.

temporal_specifications.observation_timestamp_definition: Billing cycle cutoff date T_obs (e.g. month-end).
temporal_specifications.availability_timestamp_definition: Bureau tape publication date T_avail = T_obs + Delta_T, where Delta_T is typically 30 to 45 days.

family_b_trade_credit_payment_behavior.feasibility_rationale: Distressed SMEs systematically stretch supplier trade credit (DPO) and default on vendors prior to defaulting on bank debt.

family_c_macroeconomic_and_sector_stress.description: Macroeconomic interest rate curves, sector industrial output indices, and commodity prices.

fields.name: central_bank_policy_rate
fields.description: Target benchmark policy rate (e.g. Fed Funds, ECB MRO rate).

fields.name: sovereign_yield_spread_10y_2y
fields.description: 10-year minus 2-year sovereign bond yield spread (yield curve slope).

fields.name: sector_industrial_production_index
fields.description: Monthly volume of production for 2-digit industry classification.

fields.name: sector_demand_shock_delta
fields.description: Year-over-year percentage change in monthly sector manufacturing or retail sales.

fields.name: energy_commodity_price_index
fields.description: Broad energy/fuel input commodity price index.

temporal_specifications.observation_timestamp_definition: Calendar month or trade date T_obs.
temporal_specifications.availability_timestamp_definition: Official release date of initial vintage T_pub = T_avail. Historical revisions must be indexed by vintage release date.
temporal_specifications.target_frequency_hz: Daily for rates/commodities; Monthly for production

family_c_macroeconomic_and_sector_stress.feasibility_rationale: SMEs exhibit high sensitivity to monetary tightening cycles and sector-specific demand contractions.

governance_mandate: All candidate data specifications are requirements. None may be assumed present until physically verified in repository storage.
